message.content: Reviewing the final evidence: the two follow-up probes (t12, t13) failed due to the probes' own input-generation bugs (producing infinities/FP32 overflow to inf, and an FP32-typed tensor), not due to any kernel behavior — validate_inputs correctly rejected them. The completed probes (t8, t9) found zero tolerance violations across extreme cancellation rows and 200 randomized full-range trials, with worst error/tolerance ratio 0.33. Existing claims c1 and c2 remain the right open hypotheses and are already covered; no new material, testable, in-scope problem is exposed by the new evidence.
